question:
The bar graph given here shows the data of the production of cars by three different companies X, Y, Z over the years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ccf2112e6296d1a43f6f6c34bf2347c630b678156f24165147f08fd0b28198e9.png] 

For which of the following years is the percentage rise/fall in the production from the previous year the maximum for company Y?
solution:
**Given:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ccf2112e6296d1a43f6f6c34bf2347c630b678156f24165147f08fd0b28198e9.png] 

**Calculation:**

**⇒ **For company Y,

⇒ Change in production from 2016 to 2017 = 35 – 25 =

10/25 × 100 = 40% rise

⇒ Change in production from 2017 to 2018 = 35 – 35 = 0, no change

⇒ Change in production from 2018 to 2019 = 40 – 35 = 5/35 × 100 = 14.28% rise

Change in production from 2019 to 2020 = 50 – 40 = 10/40 × 100 = 25% change

Therefore, the percentage rise/fall in the production from the previous year the maximum for company Y is in 2017.
